chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Umar ibn Yazeed, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'If a man has wealth in his possession, can he purify it (pay Zakat) when half the year has passed?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'No, but [one must wait] until the year passes over it and it becomes due upon him. Indeed, it is not for anyone to pray Salat except at its appointed time, and similarly is Zakat; and no one can Fast for the month of Ramadan except during its month, except for making up missed fasts; and every obligation is only rendered when it becomes due.'

key_terms.الْحَوْلُ: The full lunar year (period of time for Zakat)

ai.seo_question: When is the correct time to pay Zakat on wealth?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that Zakat is not an immediate voluntary act but a fixed obligation that becomes due only after the full lunar year (Hawl) has passed over the wealth. He reinforces this by drawing a parallel to the fixed timings of Salat and the specific month of Sawm, establishing a general jurisprudential principle that all divine duties (Fara'id) must be performed at their appointed times. This hadith is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the precise moment Zakat liability arises, distinguishing it from general charity (Sadaqah).

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The man happens to have some wealth in his possession, can he purify it (pay Zakāt) when half the year passes by?’ Heasws said: ‘No, but until the year passes by over it, and it becomes due upon him. It is not for anyone that he prays Salāt except in its timing, and similar to that is the Zakāt; and no one can Fast for a Month of Ramazan except during its Month, except for paying back the outstanding Fast; and every Obligation, but rather, is rendered when due’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who pays Zakat when half of the year passes. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, he must allow one year to pass. Just as it is not permissible to perform Salah (prayer) before its time, so also is Zakat. No one can fast for the month of Ramadan in a month other than the month of Ramadan. Every obligation is fulfilled when it is time for such obligation.’”
